##Setup
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(lme4)
library(performance)
library(patchwork)
library(kableExtra)
library(tidylog)
library(emmeans)
library(extrafont)
library(ggtext)
library(rempsyc)

options(scipen = 999)
```

```{r load data}

# Load (anonymized) dataset
coded_transitions <- read_csv("data/anonymized_coded_transitions.csv") %>%
  #we are omitting transition reason "activity" from analyses because only one child has this reason and comparisons can't be made. Still keep the rows for the interpersonal change value.
  mutate(transition_reason1 = ifelse(transition_reason1 == "activity", NA, transition_reason1)) %>%
  #rename the transition_category column to our new descriptor, interpersonal change, to make things clearer
  rename(int_change = transition_category) %>%
  filter(!participant %in% c(19, 50)) #These participants are twins (not with each other, but from two different sets in the data). Since only one LEQ was done per twin pair, we are removing one twin per pair from the dataset so as not to have exact duplicate rows.

# age at enrollment data
ages <- read_csv(here::here("data/starting_ages.csv")) %>%
  mutate(age_months = parse_number(starting_age),
         participant = ifelse(str_length(participant) < 2, paste0("0", participant), paste0(participant))) %>%
  filter(participant %in% coded_transitions$participant)

#demographic data
demogs <- read_csv(here::here("data/demographics.csv")) %>%
  mutate(participant = case_when(str_length(participant_value) == 1 ~ paste0("0", participant_value),
                                 TRUE ~ as.character(participant_value))) %>%
  filter(participant %in% coded_transitions$participant)

```

```{r clean data}

#calculate & label exposure dominance at every phase

coded_transitions <- coded_transitions %>%
  # if there was a third language less than 10%, the denominator was not 100, but instead the addition between English and French exposure.
  mutate(dominance_lang = case_when(
    #if L3, check if Eng to Fre ratio is greater than 0.6. If so, Eng dominant
            current_exp_L3 > 0 & current_exp_Eng/(current_exp_Eng + current_exp_Fre) > 0.6 ~ "English_dominant",
  #if L3, check if Fre to Eng ratio is greater than 0.6. If so, Fre dominant
            current_exp_L3 > 0 & current_exp_Fre/(current_exp_Eng + current_exp_Fre) > 0.6 ~ "French_dominant",
  #if L3 + L4 is greater than 0.6, then 3rd lang dominant
            rowSums(across(c(current_exp_L3, current_exp_L4)), na.rm = TRUE) > 0.6 ~ "Third_language",
  #if L3, check if Eng to Fre ratio is between 0.4 and 0.6. If so, Balanced
            current_exp_L3 > 0 & current_exp_Eng/(current_exp_Eng + current_exp_Fre) >= 0.4 & current_exp_Eng/(current_exp_Eng + current_exp_Fre) <= 0.6 ~ "Balanced",
  #if Eng greater than 0.6, Eng dominant
            current_exp_Eng > 0.6 ~ "English_dominant", 
  #if Fre greater than 0.6, Fre dominant
            current_exp_Fre > 0.6  ~ "French_dominant", 
  #if Eng between 0.4 and 0.6, Balanced
            current_exp_Eng >= 0.4 & current_exp_Eng <= 0.6 ~ "Balanced"))

#Check if any phases have 3rd language as the dominant one, if so, we'll have to exclude those or recalculate based on EN-FR only:

coded_transitions %>% 
  count(dominance_lang)

#all good, no phases where 3rd lang is over .6

```

```{r descriptive stats - reasons/types/age}
  group_by(participant) %>%
  summarize(n_transitions = n() - 1) %>% #subtract 1 to remove the initial phase
  ungroup() %>%
  summarize(mean_transitions = mean(n_transitions),
            sd_transitions = sd(n_transitions),
            min_transitions = min(n_transitions),
            max_transitions = max(n_transitions)) %>% 
  rename(Mean = mean_transitions, SD = sd_transitions, Min = min_transitions, Max = max_transitions)

  group_by(int_change) %>%
```

```{r changes to language dominance}
         mutate(change_dominance = case_when(dominance_lang == lag(dominance_lang, default = first(dominance_lang)) ~ 0,

         mutate(change_dominance = case_when(dominance_lang == lag(dominance_lang, default = first(dominance_lang)) ~ 0,

  ungroup() %>%

  arrange(desc(percent_yes)) %>% 
  rename(`Primary transition reason` = transition_reason1, 
         `N without dominance switch` = no, 
         `N with dominance switch` = yes,
```

##Models

```{r prep model data}

#--------------------function that prepares a dataset by calculating all the variables we need

transform_data_for_models <- function(dataset, remove_initial_phase = T) {
  
  dataset %>% 
    group_by(participant) %>%
    #calculate if there was a change in exposure dominance at every transition (from phase to phase)
  mutate(change_dominance = case_when(
    dominance_lang == lag(dominance_lang, default = first(dominance_lang)) ~ 0,
    dominance_lang != lag(dominance_lang, default = first(dominance_lang)) ~ 1)) %>%
  
    #Determine exposure dominance at time 1 and copy to every row
  mutate(t1_dominance = case_when(int_change == "initial_phase" ~ dominance_lang)) %>%
  fill(t1_dominance, .direction = "down") %>%
  
    #Calculate exposure of dominant language at phase 1 and copy to every row
  mutate(t1_domlang_exp = case_when(
    int_change == "initial_phase" & current_exp_Eng > current_exp_Fre ~ current_exp_Eng,
    int_change == "initial_phase" & current_exp_Eng < current_exp_Fre ~ current_exp_Fre, 
    int_change == "initial_phase" & current_exp_Eng == current_exp_Fre ~ current_exp_Eng)) %>% 
  fill(t1_domlang_exp, .direction = "down") %>%
  ungroup() %>%
    
  #Calculate current exposure of time 1 dominant language
  mutate(t1_domlang_curr_exp = case_when(
    t1_dominance == "English_dominant" ~ current_exp_Eng,
    t1_dominance == "French_dominant" ~ current_exp_Fre,
    t1_dominance == "Balanced" & current_exp_Eng > current_exp_Fre ~ current_exp_Eng,
    t1_dominance == "Balanced" & current_exp_Fre >= current_exp_Eng ~ current_exp_Fre)) %>% 
  
  # Calculate the absolute change in exposure based on Time 1 dominance exp 
  mutate(abs_change_t1_domlang = abs(t1_domlang_curr_exp - t1_domlang_exp)) %>%
    
  # create factor categorical version of the change dominance variable in case we want to use this
  mutate(change_dominance_fct = factor(case_when(change_dominance == 1 ~ "yes_change",
                                                 change_dominance == 0 ~ "no_change"))) %>% 
  group_by(participant) %>% 
    
  # Calculate the absolute change in exposure phase by phase 
  mutate(t1_domlang_curr_exp_lag = lag(t1_domlang_curr_exp, default = first(t1_domlang_curr_exp)),
         abs_change_t1_domlang_phase = abs(t1_domlang_curr_exp - t1_domlang_curr_exp_lag)) %>%
    
  # Remove initial phase from dataset, as these do not count as transitions
    { if (remove_initial_phase == T) filter(., int_change != "initial_phase") else . } %>%
  # remove the one kid who has no transitions
    { if (remove_initial_phase == F) filter(., max(row_number()) > 1) else . } %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
    
  # convert exposure into percentages in case models work better with larger numbers
  mutate(t1_domlang_exp_pct = t1_domlang_exp * 100,
         t1_domlang_curr_exp_pct = t1_domlang_curr_exp * 100,
         abs_change_t1_domlang_pct = abs_change_t1_domlang * 100,
         abs_change_t1_domlang_phase_pct = abs_change_t1_domlang_phase * 100) %>% 

  # Select relevant variables
  select(participant, phase, phase_length, start_age, int_change, primary_transition_reason = transition_reason1,
         dominance_lang, change_dominance, change_dominance_fct, t1_dominance, 
         t1_domlang_exp, t1_domlang_exp_pct, 
         t1_domlang_curr_exp, t1_domlang_curr_exp_pct, 
         abs_change_t1_domlang, abs_change_t1_domlang_pct,
         abs_change_t1_domlang_phase, abs_change_t1_domlang_phase_pct) %>%
  # for case where first phase remains, add a value to nterpersonal change for first phase
    mutate(int_change = case_when(phase == 1 ~ "birth_phase_no_transition",
                                        TRUE ~ int_change),
           #centre start age for the models with age
           start_age_centred = as.numeric(scale(start_age, scale = F)))
}

#------------------------------ With interpersonal change grouped into 4 levels 

model_data_4lvls <- coded_transitions %>%
  mutate(int_change = case_when(
    int_change == "Speaker"|
      int_change == "StrategyTime"|
      int_change == "SpeakerStrategy"|
      int_change == "SpeakerStrategyTime" ~ "Other", 
    TRUE ~ int_change)) %>%
  transform_data_for_models() %>% 
  mutate(int_change = factor(int_change, levels = c("Time", "SpeakerTime", "Strategy", "Other")))

#------------------------------ With int_change grouped into 5 levels & transition_reason1 grouped into 5 levels

model_data_5lvls <- coded_transitions %>%
  mutate(int_change = case_when(
    int_change == "Speaker"|
      int_change == "StrategyTime"|
      int_change == "SpeakerStrategy" ~ "Other", 
    TRUE ~ int_change)) %>% 
  mutate(transition_reason1 = case_when(
           transition_reason1 %in% c("COVID", "daycare", "caregiving arrangement", "language approach") ~ transition_reason1,
           TRUE ~ "other")
         ) %>%
  transform_data_for_models() %>%
  mutate(int_change = factor(int_change, levels = c("Strategy", "Time", "SpeakerTime", "SpeakerStrategyTime", "Other")))

```

###Dominance change
####By interpersonal change
```{r dom change by interpersonal 4lvls}

#-------------Change in exposure dominance group, our dependent variable for this model, was a categorical variable with two levels (yes/no) resulting in a binomial distribution. Therefore, we used binomial mixed effects models. The check_model function showed fewer outliers when using the probit link over the logit link, so that's what we used here.

#-------------------------------------------- Model assumptions

# Check what model fits the data best using the performanceR package, see "The Perfomance" workflow: https://easystats.github.io/performance/ (this already includes the qqnorm that we were using)


#-------------- with transition type as 4-level predictor

#----------------------- Model without age
model_dom_4lvls_basic <- glmer(change_dominance ~ int_change + ( 1| participant), data = model_data_4lvls, family = binomial(link = "probit"))

# Model assumption check
check_model(model_dom_4lvls_basic)

#----------------------- Model with age centred, additive
model_dom_4lvls_age_add <- glmer(change_dominance ~ int_change + start_age_centred + ( 1| participant), data = model_data_4lvls, family = binomial(link = "probit"))

# Model assumption check
check_model(model_dom_4lvls_age_add)

#----------------------- Model with age centred, interaction ********* FAILS TO CONVERGE
model_dom_4lvls_age_interact <- glmer(change_dominance ~ int_change * start_age_centred + ( 1| participant), data = model_data_4lvls, family = binomial(link = "probit"))

# Model assumption check
check_model(model_dom_4lvls_age_interact)

#----------------------- Compare all models with 4-level predictor
model_dom_4lvls_comparison <- compare_performance(model_dom_4lvls_basic, model_dom_4lvls_age_add, model_dom_4lvls_age_interact, rank = TRUE) 

# results table
model_dom_4lvls_comparison %>% 
  kbl(col.names = c("Model Name", "Model Type","R2 Conditional", "R2 Marginal", "ICC", "RMSE", "Sigma", "Log Loss", "Score Log", "Score Spherical", "AIC wt", "AICc wt", "BIC wt", "Performance Score"), digits = 3, booktabs = T) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "HOLD_position", "scale_down"))

#Basic model wins

#Summary of basic model
summary(model_dom_4lvls_basic)
#Looks like the Strategy nterpersonal change is the only one that statistically affects dominance, negatively (so reduces the odds of a change in dominance), compared to the intercept level (Time)

#----------------------- Test likelihood ratios to see if models are statistically significantly different from one another

# No comparisons are statistically different (first row always has NAs as the other model(s) are compared to it)

#Basic vs additive
model_dom_4lvls_basic_vs_add <- test_likelihoodratio(model_dom_4lvls_basic, model_dom_4lvls_age_add) 

model_dom_4lvls_basic_vs_add %>% 
  rownames_to_column("model_name") %>% 
  select(-c(1)) %>%
  kbl(col.names = c("Model Name", "Model Type","DF", "DF Difference", "Chi2", "p"),
      digits = 3, booktabs = T) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = F, font_size = 8, latex_options = c("striped", "HOLD_position"))

#Basic vs interaction
model_dom_4lvls_basic_vs_interact <- test_likelihoodratio(model_dom_4lvls_basic, model_dom_4lvls_age_interact)

model_dom_4lvls_basic_vs_interact %>% 
  rownames_to_column("model_name") %>% 
  select(-c(1))%>%
  kbl(col.names = c("Model Name", "Model Type","DF", "DF Difference", "Chi2", "p"),
      digits = 3, booktabs = T) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = F, font_size = 8, latex_options = c("striped", "HOLD_position"))

#Additive vs interaction
model_dom_4lvls_add_vs_interact <- test_likelihoodratio(model_dom_4lvls_age_add, model_dom_4lvls_age_interact)

model_dom_4lvls_add_vs_interact %>% 
  rownames_to_column("model_name") %>% 
  select(-c(1))%>%
  kbl(col.names = c("Model Name", "Model Type","DF", "DF Difference", "Chi2", "p"),
      digits = 3, booktabs = T) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = F, font_size = 8, latex_options = c("striped", "HOLD_position"))

#----------------------- Pairwise comparisons to see which interpersonal changes are different from one another

summary(model_dom_4lvls_basic)
model_dom_4lvls_basic_emms <- emmeans(model_dom_4lvls_basic, "int_change")
summary(model_dom_4lvls_basic_emms)
pairs(model_dom_4lvls_basic_emms)

#Strategy is different from Time and SpeakerTime


```

```{r dom change by interpersonal 5lvls}
# Model assumption check
check_model(model_dom_5lvls_basic)

#----------------------- Model with age centred
model_dom_5lvls_age_add <- glmer(change_dominance ~ int_change + start_age_centred + ( 1| participant), data = model_data_5lvls, family = binomial(link = "probit"))

# Model assumption check
check_model(model_dom_5lvls_age_add)

#----------------------- Model with age centred, interaction ********* FAILS TO CONVERGE
model_dom_5lvls_age_interact <- glmer(change_dominance ~ int_change * start_age_centred + ( 1| participant), data = model_data_5lvls, family = binomial(link = "probit"))

# Model assumption check
check_model(model_dom_5lvls_age_interact)

#----------------------- Compare all models with 5-level predictor
model_dom_5lvls_comparison <- compare_performance(model_dom_5lvls_basic, model_dom_5lvls_age_add, model_dom_5lvls_age_interact, rank = TRUE) 

# results table
model_dom_5lvls_comparison %>% 
  kbl(col.names = c("Model Name", "Model Type","R2 Conditional", "R2 Marginal", "ICC", "RMSE", "Sigma", "Log Loss", "Score Log", "Score Spherical", "AIC wt", "AICc wt", "BIC wt", "Performance Score"), digits = 3, booktabs = T) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("striped", "HOLD_position", "scale_down"))

#Basic model wins

#Summary of basic model
summary(model_dom_5lvls_basic)

#Looks like the Strategy interpersonal change is the only one that statistically affects dominance, negatively (so reduces the odds of a change in dominance), compared to the intercept (Time)

#----------------------- Test likelihood ratios to see if models are statistically significantly different from one another

# No comparisons are statistically different

#Basic vs additive
model_dom_5lvls_basic_vs_add <- test_likelihoodratio(model_dom_5lvls_basic, model_dom_5lvls_age_add) 

model_dom_5lvls_basic_vs_add %>% 
  rownames_to_column("model_name") %>% 
  select(-c(1)) %>%
  kbl(col.names = c("Model Name", "Model Type","DF", "DF Difference", "Chi2", "p"),
      digits = 3, booktabs = T) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = F, font_size = 8, latex_options = c("striped", "HOLD_position"))

#Basic vs interaction
model_dom_5lvls_basic_vs_interact <- test_likelihoodratio(model_dom_5lvls_basic, model_dom_5lvls_age_interact)

model_dom_5lvls_basic_vs_interact %>% 
  rownames_to_column("model_name") %>% 
  select(-c(1))%>%
  kbl(col.names = c("Model Name", "Model Type","DF", "DF Difference", "Chi2", "p"),
      digits = 3, booktabs = T) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = F, font_size = 8, latex_options = c("striped", "HOLD_position"))

#Additive vs interaction
model_dom_5lvls_add_vs_interact <- test_likelihoodratio(model_dom_5lvls_age_add, model_dom_5lvls_age_interact)

model_dom_5lvls_add_vs_interact %>% 
  rownames_to_column("model_name") %>% 
  select(-c(1))%>%
  kbl(col.names = c("Model Name", "Model Type","DF", "DF Difference", "Chi2", "p"),
      digits = 3, booktabs = T) %>%
  kable_styling(full_width = F, font_size = 8, latex_options = c("striped", "HOLD_position"))

#----------------------- Pairwise comparisons to see which interpersonal changes are different from one another

summary(model_dom_5lvls_basic)
model_dom_5lvls_basic_emms <- emmeans(model_dom_5lvls_basic, "int_change")
pairs(model_dom_5lvls_basic_emms) 

#Strategy is different from Time, SpeakerTime, and SpeakerStrategyTime
```

###Absolute Exposure Change
```{r descriptives on exposure change}

#Wanted to keep initial phase for a more meaningful intercept, but the model doesn't like it because there is no variation (all exposure change values are zero for this phase). Therefore, look at the pairwise comparisons for the most meaningful effects.

#-------------------------------------------- Average change to exposure per transition
model_data_5lvls %>% 
  summarize(mean_change = mean(abs_change_t1_domlang_phase),
            sd_change = sd(abs_change_t1_domlang_phase),
            min_change = min(abs_change_t1_domlang_phase),
            max_change = max(abs_change_t1_domlang_phase))

#-------------------------------------------- Average change to exposure by transition reason
model_data_5lvls %>% 
  group_by(primary_transition_reason) %>%
  summarize(mean_change = mean(abs_change_t1_domlang_phase),
            sd_change = sd(abs_change_t1_domlang_phase),
            min_change = min(abs_change_t1_domlang_phase),
            max_change = max(abs_change_t1_domlang_phase)) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_change))

#-------------------------------------------- Average change to exposure by interpersonal change
model_data_5lvls %>% 
  group_by(int_change) %>%
  summarize(mean_change = mean(abs_change_t1_domlang_phase),
            sd_change = sd(abs_change_t1_domlang_phase),
            min_change = min(abs_change_t1_domlang_phase),
            max_change = max(abs_change_t1_domlang_phase)) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_change))

```

```{r abs change by reason}

#Check if age makes a difference in these models

#----------------------- Model for Reasons without age

model_abs_change_reasons_basic <- lmerTest::lmer(abs_change_t1_domlang_phase ~ primary_transition_reason + (1|participant), data = model_data_5lvls)

summary(model_abs_change_reasons_basic)

#----------------------- Model for Reasons with age additive

model_abs_change_reasons_age_add <- lmerTest::lmer(abs_change_t1_domlang_phase ~ primary_transition_reason + start_age_centred + (1|participant), data = model_data_5lvls)

summary(model_abs_change_reasons_age_add)

#----------------------- Model for Reasons with age interactive

model_abs_change_reasons_age_interact <- lmerTest::lmer(abs_change_t1_domlang_phase ~ primary_transition_reason * start_age_centred + (1|participant), data = model_data_5lvls)

summary(model_abs_change_reasons_age_interact)

model_abs_reasons_comparison <- compare_performance(model_abs_change_reasons_basic, model_abs_change_reasons_age_add, model_abs_change_reasons_age_interact, rank = TRUE) 

# results table
model_abs_reasons_comparison #interaction model has best performance



#----------------------- Pairwise comparisons to see which reasons are different from one another 

#our interaction term is continuous, so try looking at a few levels of age

summary(model_abs_change_reasons_age_interact)

#ages to pinpoint in comparisons: 5, 15, 25 (use the centred variables)
start_age_points <- c(-9.2346154, 0.7653846, 10.7653846)

model_abs_change_reasons_interact_emms_points <- emmeans(model_abs_change_reasons_age_interact, specs = ~ primary_transition_reason | start_age_centred, 
                         at = list(start_age_centred = start_age_points))

pairs(model_abs_change_reasons_interact_emms_points)

#At lower ages, absolute changes phase-to-phase are similar. At older ages, the reasons diverge, with trip/relocation (called Other in the model) causing larger changes at older ages and language approach causing smaller changes at older ages.

#our interaction term is continuous, so try comparing the slopes

model_abs_change_reasons_interact_emms_slopes <- emtrends(model_abs_change_reasons_age_interact, specs = ~ primary_transition_reason, var = "start_age_centred")

pairs(model_abs_change_reasons_interact_emms_slopes)

#only language approach and other (trip/relocation) have significantly different slopes

#quickly look at data to make sense of coefficients
model_data_5lvls %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = start_age_centred, y = abs_change_t1_domlang_phase, color = primary_transition_reason)) + 
  geom_point() + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = F, span = 2)

```

##Figures

```{r load required font}
#----------------------- Only run this bit if you're making the plots on a new computer and have to load the font into R. The font file is included in the R Project files and you must install it on your computer first before running this code.

add_font <- "no" #Set this to "yes" if you need to load the font into R in order for the following graphs to display properly

if (add_font == "yes") {
  
  library(showtext)     # renders custom fonts in R graphics
  library(sysfonts)     # font_add() for loading local fonts
  library(systemfonts)  # match_font() for finding installed fonts
  
  # Find the installed font file automatically (works on Mac and PC)
  font_path <- match_fonts("Graph_icons")$path
  # Register it with showtext — give it any nickname you want
  font_add(family = "Graph_icons", regular = font_path)
  # Tell showtext to automatically render fonts in all plots
  showtext_auto()
  # Set DPI — use 300 for saving
  showtext_opts(dpi = 300)
}

```

```{r primary reasons barplot}

icons_order <- c(1, 2, 4, 3, 5, 6)
icons_order <- c("daycare" = 1, "caregiving arrangement" = 2, "language approach" = 4, "COVID" = 3, "trip" = 5, "relocation" = 6)
transition_reason_labels <- c("Daycare", "Caregiving\narrangement", "Language\napproach", "COVID", "Trip", "Relocation")
fill_colours <- c("SpeakerStrategy" = "#C19F61", "StrategyTime" = "#EEC44E", "Speaker" = "#94C162", "SpeakerStrategyTime" = "#EE6AAD",  "Strategy" = "#9F9BCA", "Time" = "#E48F4E", "SpeakerTime" = "#60BBA0")

reasons_plot <- coded_transitions %>%
  pivot_longer(starts_with("transition_reason"), names_to = "column", values_to = "transition_reason") %>% 
  filter(transition_reason != "initial_phase" & !is.na(transition_reason) & transition_reason != "activity") %>% 
  count(transition_reason, int_change) %>%
  group_by(transition_reason) %>%
  mutate(icon_num = icons_order[transition_reason]) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(total = sum(n),
         percent = n/total) %>%
  arrange(-total, -percent) %>%
  mutate(percentage = scales::percent(percent),
         percent = round(percent, digits = 4),
         transition_reason = ifelse(transition_reason != "COVID", str_to_sentence(transition_reason), transition_reason),
         transition_reason = paste0( "<br />", str_replace(transition_reason, "\\s", "<br />"))) %>%
  mutate(transition_reason = paste0("<span style='font-family:Graph_icons;'> ", icon_num, "</span>", "<span style='font-family:sans;'>", transition_reason, "</span>")) %>% 
  mutate(transition_reason = fct_inorder(transition_reason)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = transition_reason, y = percent, fill = int_change)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = fill_colours) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent, limits = c(0, .5)) +
     labs(
       title = "Reasons for transitions in children's language environment",
       x = "\nReason for transition",
       y = "Percent of transitions\n",
       fill = "Interpersonal change"
     ) +
     theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
     theme(
         panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
         panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linewidth = .15),
         plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
         plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "white"),
         panel.background = element_blank(),
         axis.text.x.bottom = ggtext::element_markdown(lineheight = 1.2),
         plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
         plot.title.position = "plot",
         legend.position = "right"
     )

reasons_plot 

ggsave("figures/reasons_barplot.png", reasons_plot, width = 10, height = 6, units = "in", dpi = 300)

```

```{r timecourse icons plot}

#---------------------------------------------------Create dataframe for figure

timeline_fig_dataset <- coded_transitions %>%
  filter(int_change != "initial_phase") %>%
   group_by(participant) %>%
   mutate(n_part_trans = n()) %>%
   ungroup() %>%
   arrange(n_part_trans) %>%
    mutate(participant = factor(participant, levels = unique(participant))) %>%
  mutate(int_change = fct_infreq(int_change),     # Reorder int_change by frequency
    transition_reason1 = fct_infreq(transition_reason1)     
    # Reorder transition_reason by frequency
  ) %>%
  mutate(participant_ordered = data.table::rleid(participant))

# Create the main plot

#---------------------------------------------------Create fake legend to use with our new icons

                            y = c(3, 2.5, 2, 1.5, 1, .5),

                             label = paste("   ", c("SpeakerStrategy", "StrategyTime", "Speaker","SpeakerStrategyTime",  "Strategy", "Time", "SpeakerTime")))

legend_icons <- legend_data_icons %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = x, y = y)) +

legend_colors <- legend_data_colors %>%

library(patchwork)

legends <- legend_colors / legend_icons

#------------------------------------------------------------Create the main plot

time_plot <- timeline_fig_dataset %>%
  #Remove two rows where the transition reason was coded as activity, as we are omitting this reason from analyses
  filter(!is.na(transition_reason1)) %>%
     mutate (num = as.numeric(transition_reason1),
             ) %>%
     ggplot(aes(
         x = start_age, 
         y = participant_ordered, 
         color = int_change, 
     )) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = unique(timeline_fig_dataset$participant_ordered), color = "#EBEBEB") +
     geom_text(aes(label = num), family = "Graph_icons", alpha = 0.7, size = 4.5, position = position_jitter(width = .15, height = 0)) + 
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "darkgray", linewidth = 0.5) +
     scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2") +
     scale_x_continuous(
         breaks = c(0, seq(3, 30, by = 3)),
         labels = c("Birth", seq(3, 30, by = 3)),
         limits = c(0, 30),
         expand = c(0, 0)
     ) +
     scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(1.5, 1.5))) +
     labs(
         x = "Age\n(Months)",
         y = "Participants"
     ) +
     theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
     theme(
         legend.position = "none",
         panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
         panel.grid = element_line(linewidth = .15),
         axis.text.y = element_blank(),
         plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
         plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "white"),
         panel.background = element_blank()
     )

#--------------------------------------------- Create a histogram for the x-axis (ages) 
#add a special fill for our two peaks, 1 month and 11 months
x_hist <- timeline_fig_dataset %>%
  mutate(peak = case_when(start_age %in% c(1, 11) ~ "#8eb7e6",
                          TRUE ~ "lightgrey"),
         peak_text = case_when(start_age == 1 ~ "    1-month peak",
                               start_age == 11 ~ "    11-month peak",
                               TRUE ~ "")) %>%
  group_by(start_age, peak, peak_text) %>%
  summarize(n = n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = start_age, y = n)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = peak), color = "darkgrey", width = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = peak_text), y = 18, hjust = 0, color = "#8eb7e6", size = 4) +
  scale_fill_identity() +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 30),
                     expand = c(0, 0)) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_blank(),  # Hide x-axis title
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),   # Hide x-axis text
    axis.title.y = element_text(lineheight = .8),
    axis.text.y = element_text(margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 5)),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),    # Remove gridlines
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 15),
    panel.background = element_blank()
  ) + 
  labs(y = "Count by\nage")

#--------------------------------------------- Create a histogram for the y-axis (by participant)
y_hist <- timeline_fig_dataset %>%
  count(participant) %>%
  ggplot(aes(y = participant, x = n)) +
  geom_col(fill = "lightgrey", color = "darkgrey") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(add = c(1.5, 1.5))) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = function(x) seq(from = 0, to = ceiling(max(x)), by = 2)) + 
  theme(
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(), 
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 5, 15),
    panel.background = element_blank()
  ) +
  labs(x = "Count by\nparticipant")

#--------------------------------------------- Combine using patchwork
# A is main plot, B is x histogram, C is y histogram, D is top legend and E is bottom legend 

layout <- "
BBBBBBBBBBBBBBBBB############

"

combined_plot <- time_plot + x_hist + y_hist + legend_colors + legend_icons +
```

```{r abs change reasons 3 timepoints plot}

#ages to pinpoint in comparisons: 5, 15, 25 (use the centred variables)
start_age_points <- c(-9.2346154, 0.7653846, 10.7653846)

transition_reason_labels <- c("daycare" = "Daycare", "caregiving arrangement" = "Caregiving arrangement", "language approach" = "Language approach", "COVID" = "COVID", "other" = "Trip/Relocation")

#Get the means for those three time points
model_abs_change_reasons_interact_emms_points <- emmeans(model_abs_change_reasons_age_interact, specs = ~ primary_transition_reason | start_age_centred, 
                         at = list(start_age_centred = start_age_points))

abs_change_reasons_plot_data <- model_abs_change_reasons_interact_emms_points %>%
  as_tibble()

contrast_levels_reasons <- abs_change_reasons_plot_data %>%
  distinct(primary_transition_reason)

contrast_levels_reasons <- crossing(contrast_levels_reasons, contrast_levels_reasons %>% rename(pair2 = primary_transition_reason)) %>%
  filter(primary_transition_reason != pair2) %>%
  mutate(contrast = paste(primary_transition_reason, "-", pair2)) %>%
  left_join(abs_change_reasons_plot_data %>% select(start_age_centred, pair2 = primary_transition_reason, emmean2 = emmean)) 

#This shows which pairs are significantly different at which time points
abs_change_reasons_signif <- pairs(model_abs_change_reasons_interact_emms_points) %>%
  as_tibble()

abs_change_reasons_plot_data <- abs_change_reasons_plot_data %>% 
  left_join(contrast_levels_reasons) %>%
  mutate(primary_transition_reason = transition_reason_labels[as.character(primary_transition_reason)])

signif_star_placement_reasons <- abs_change_reasons_plot_data %>%
  left_join(abs_change_reasons_signif %>% select(contrast, start_age_centred, p.value)) %>%
  mutate(signif = ifelse(p.value <= .05, "signif", "not_signif"),
         signif_label = case_when(p.value < .001 ~ "***",
                                   p.value < .01 ~ "**",
                                   p.value < .05 ~ "*",
                                   TRUE ~ ""),
         signif_placement = (emmean + emmean2)/2) %>%
  filter(signif_label != "") %>% 
  group_by(start_age_centred) %>% 
  mutate(adjustx = data.table::rleid(contrast)*0.5) %>% 
  ungroup() %>% 
  mutate(start_age_og = start_age_centred,
         start_age_centred = start_age_centred + adjustx)

color_shades <- c("Caregiving arrangement" = "#1e83a6", "COVID" = "#b2553c", "Daycare" = "#b2e729", "Language approach" = "#b668bf", "Trip/Relocation" = "#4bd8c5")

abs_change_reasons_plot_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = start_age_centred, y = emmean, color = primary_transition_reason)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = start_age_centred, yend = emmean2), data = signif_star_placement_reasons, color = "black") +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = start_age_centred - 0.25, yend = emmean), data = signif_star_placement_reasons, color = "black") +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = start_age_centred - 0.25, y = emmean2, yend = emmean2), data = signif_star_placement_reasons, color = "black") +
  geom_text(aes(label = signif_label, y = ((emmean+emmean2)/2)), data = signif_star_placement_reasons, angle = -90, color = "black", vjust = 0.4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = color_shades) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-9.2346154, 0.7653846, 10.7653846), labels = c("5 months", "15 months", "25 months"), limits = c(-10, 15)) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.4)) +
  labs(title = "Pairwise comparisons of EMMs at three time points",
       y = "Estimated Marginal Mean\n",
       x = "\nAge in months",
       color = "Primary Transition Reason") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "white"),
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        plot.title.position = "plot") +
   guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1,
                              title.position = "top", 
                              title.hjust = 0.5))
```

##Tables
```{r descriptives}

#-------------------------------------------- Overall frequency and percentage

coded_transitions %>%
  group_by(participant) %>%
  summarize(n_transitions = n() - 1) %>% #subtract 1 to remove the initial phase
  ungroup() %>%
  summarize(mean_transitions = mean(n_transitions),
            sd_transitions = sd(n_transitions),
            min_transitions = min(n_transitions),
            max_transitions = max(n_transitions)) %>% 
  rename(Mean = mean_transitions, SD = sd_transitions, Min = min_transitions, Max = max_transitions) %>%
  nice_table(title = c("Table 1", "Frequency of transitions"), width = 1) 


#-------------------------------------------- By transition type/interpersonal change

coded_transitions %>%
  filter(int_change != "initial_phase") %>% # filter initial phase since we are not interested in this "type" - no transitions can occur at phase 1
  group_by(int_change) %>%
  summarize(number_transitions = n()) %>%
  mutate(perc_decimal = number_transitions / sum(number_transitions)) %>% 
  arrange(-perc_decimal) %>%
  mutate(percentage = scales::percent(perc_decimal)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-perc_decimal) %>% 
  rename(`Interpersonal Change` = int_change, 
         Frequency = number_transitions, 
         Percentage = percentage) %>%
  nice_table(title = c("Table 2", "Frequency of transitions by interpersonal change"), width = 1) 


#-------------------------------------------- By transition reason

coded_transitions %>%
  pivot_longer(starts_with("transition_reason"), names_to = "column", values_to = "transition_reason") %>% 
  filter(transition_reason != "initial_phase" & transition_reason != "activity") %>% 
  janitor::tabyl(transition_reason) %>%
  arrange(-percent) %>%
  mutate(percentage = scales::percent(percent),
         percent = round(percent, digits = 4),
         transition_reason = ifelse(transition_reason != "COVID", str_to_sentence(transition_reason), transition_reason)) %>% 
  select(-percent) %>% 
  rename(`Transition Reason` = transition_reason, 
         Frequency = n, 
         Percentage = percentage) %>%
  nice_table(title = c("Table 3", "Frequency of transitions by transition reason"), width = 1) 

#-------------------------------------------- Mean and SD changes in dominance

coded_transitions %>%
  group_by(participant) %>%
  filter(n() > 1) %>%
          #calculate if there was a change in exposure dominance at every transition (from phase to phase)
         mutate(change_dominance = case_when(dominance_lang == lag(dominance_lang, default = first(dominance_lang)) ~ 0,
                                      dominance_lang != lag(dominance_lang, default = first(dominance_lang)) ~ 1)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  select(participant, phase, int_change, contains("curr"), dominance_lang, change_dominance) %>% 
  group_by(participant) %>%
  summarize(change_in_dominance = sum(change_dominance)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  summarize(Mean = mean(change_in_dominance),
            SD = sd(change_in_dominance),
            Min = min(change_in_dominance),
            Max = max(change_in_dominance)) %>% 
  nice_table(title = c("Table 4", "Frequency of language dominance switches"), width = 1) 


#-------------------------------------------- Primary reason only
coded_transitions %>%
  group_by(participant) %>%
          #calculate if there was a change in exposure dominance at every transition (from phase to phase)
         mutate(change_dominance = case_when(dominance_lang == lag(dominance_lang, default = first(dominance_lang)) ~ 0,
                                      dominance_lang != lag(dominance_lang, default = first(dominance_lang)) ~ 1)) %>%
  ungroup() %>% 
  filter(int_change != "initial_phase" & transition_reason1 != "activity") %>% 
  select(participant, phase, transition_reason1, contains("curr"), dominance_lang, change_dominance) %>% 
  group_by(transition_reason1) %>%
  count(change_dominance) %>%
  mutate(change_dominance = ifelse(change_dominance == 1, "yes", "no")) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = "change_dominance", values_from = "n") %>%
  mutate(yes = ifelse(is.na(yes), 0, yes),
         percent_yes = yes/(yes +  no)*100,
         transition_reason1 = ifelse(transition_reason1 != "COVID", str_to_sentence(transition_reason1), transition_reason1)) %>%
  arrange(desc(percent_yes)) %>% 
  rename(`Primary transition reason` = transition_reason1, 
         `N without dominance switch` = no, 
         `N with dominance switch` = yes,
         `Percent with dominance switch` = percent_yes) %>%
  nice_table(title = c("Table 5", "Frequency of language dominance switches by primary transition reason"), width = 1) 


#-------------------------------------------- Interpersonal Change by transition reason
coded_transitions %>%
  filter(int_change != "initial_phase") %>% # filter initial phase since we are not interested in this "type" - no transitions can occur at phase 1
  group_by(int_change, transition_reason1) %>%
  summarize(number_transitions = n()) %>%
  group_by(int_change) %>%
  mutate(perc_decimal = number_transitions / sum(number_transitions)) %>% 
  arrange(int_change, -perc_decimal) %>%
  mutate(percentage = scales::percent(perc_decimal),
         transition_reason1 = ifelse(transition_reason1 == "COVID", "COVID", str_to_sentence(transition_reason1))) %>%
  group_by(int_change) %>%
  mutate(tot = sum(number_transitions)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(tot), desc(number_transitions)) %>%
  rename(`Primary transition reason` = transition_reason1, `n` = number_transitions, Percent = percentage) %>%
  select(-int_change, -perc_decimal, - tot) %>%
  tinytable::tt(# Left-align first column, right-align numeric columns
                align = "lrrrr" ) %>%
  style_table() %>%
  tinytable::group_tt(i = list(
    "SpeakerTime" = 1,
    "Time" = 6,
    "Strategy" = 10,
    "SpeakerStrategyTime" = 14,
    "Speaker" = 17,
    "StrategyTime" = 20,
    "SpeakerStrategy" = 23
  )) %>%
  tinytable::save_tt("my_output_table.docx", overwrite = TRUE)


#-------------------------------------------- Transition reason by Interpersonal Change 
coded_transitions %>%
  filter(int_change != "initial_phase") %>% # filter initial phase since we are not interested in this "type" - no transitions can occur at phase 1
  group_by(int_change, transition_reason1) %>%
  summarize(number_transitions = n()) %>%
  group_by(transition_reason1) %>%
  mutate(perc_decimal = number_transitions / sum(number_transitions)) %>% 
  arrange(int_change, -perc_decimal) %>%
  mutate(percentage = scales::percent(perc_decimal),
         transition_reason1 = ifelse(transition_reason1 == "COVID", "COVID", str_to_sentence(transition_reason1))) %>%
  group_by(transition_reason1) %>%
  mutate(tot = sum(number_transitions)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  arrange(desc(tot), desc(number_transitions)) %>%
  select(int_change, number_transitions, percentage) %>%
  rename(`Interpersonal change` = int_change, `Frequency` = number_transitions, Percent = percentage) %>%
  tinytable::tt(# Left-align first column, right-align numeric columns
                align = "lrrrr" ) %>%
  style_table() %>%
  tinytable::group_tt(i = list(
    "Daycare" = 1,
    "Caregiving arrangement" = 7,
    "COVID" = 13,
    "Language approach" = 17,
    "Trip" = 18,
    "Relocation" = 22
  )) %>%
  tinytable::save_tt("my_output_table.docx", overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r dominance change models}
#-----------------Pairwise comparisons for Dominance switch by interpersonal change model

style_table <- function(data) {
  data %>%
  tinytable::style_tt(
        i = 0,             # Header row
        line = "t", # Top and bottom lines for the header
        line_color = "black"
    ) %>%
    tinytable::style_tt(
        i = nrow(data), # Bottom row of the data
        line = "b",    # Bottom line for the table body
        line_color = "black"
    ) 
}

as.data.frame(broom::tidy(pairs(model_dom_5lvls_basic_emms))) %>%
  select(Contrast = contrast, Estimate = estimate, `Std. Error` = std.error, df, Statistic = statistic, `Adjusted p-value` = adj.p.value) %>%
  mutate(df = "\u221E") %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3))) %>%
  tinytable::tt(# Left-align first column, right-align numeric columns
                align = "lrrrr" ) %>%
    tinytable::style_tt(
        i = which(`Adjusted p-value` < .05), 
        j = "Adjusted p-value", 
        bold = TRUE
    ) %>%
  style_table() %>%
  tinytable::save_tt("my_output_table.docx", overwrite = TRUE)
```
